items.text: नारदाद्याश्च मुनयो यमं धर्मभृतां वरम् प्रणम्य सुखमासीनं वृद्धं ज्ञानविदां वरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पप्रच्छुर्वैदिकं कर्म सर्वलोकोपकारकम् सर्वपापक्षयकरं श्रवणाज्ञानमहत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: महर्षे सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यमो न त्वात्रिलोचनम् संगृह्य धर्मशास्त्राणि सर्वलोकोपकारकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सुप्तोत्थाय उषः प्रातः आचम्याथहरं स्मरेत् उत्थायनैरृते देसे मलमूत्रे विसर्जयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ग्रामाहुरतरङ्गत्वा तृणैराच्छाद्य मेदिनीम् शिरः प्रावृत्य वस्त्रेण पिधायास्यं करेण च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: उत्तरादिमुखः कुर्यात्संध्ययोर्मलमूत्रकम् दिवोत्तरामुखः कुर्याद्रात्रौ याम्यहरिङ्मुखः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रत्यङ्मुखस्तु पूर्वाह्णे पराह्णे हरिदिण्मुखः न केदारे न सेतौ च नाशुचौ न च भूरुहे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: गण्डूषयेन्मूत्रयेद्वा नदीदेवालयान्तिके दन्तशुद्धिं च यः कुर्यात्पच्यते नरकादिना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: गृहीतशिश्नश्चोत्थाय मौनीवस्त्रावकुण्ठितः पूर्वमुद्धृततोयेन शौचं कुर्यात्तथा मृदा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न मार्गस्थानवल्मीकानोषरस्थाखुसंचितात् नान्यशिष्टां च नार्द्रां च शौचार्थं मृदमाहरेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: गुदेष्टाभिर्द्वादशभिः मृद्भिः षोडशभिश्च वा चतुर्विंशतिभिश्चापि द्वात्रिंशद्भिरथापि वा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न्यूनाधिकानकर्तव्या असंख्याश्च वृथा भवेत् यावद्गन्धक्षयो वापि शौचं कुर्याद्विशुद्धये
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आद्यन्तशोधनं कुर्यात् शौचस्थलमहर्निशम् नोचेत्पितॄन्भक्षयति स्वयं चाशुचितां व्रजेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: लिङ्गेति सः करे वामे दशासप्त च दक्षिणे पादयोः सप्त वा तिस्रो मृदामलकमात्रया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऐवं मलविसर्गे तु मूत्रशौचे तु कथ्यते एकालिङ्गे करे तिस्रः द्वे वा पञ्च च हस्तयोः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सव्यहस्तं बहिर्जानौ अपश्यैव तदन्तरा एवं शोचं द्विजः कृत्वा आजानुक्षालयेत्पदे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शौचमित्थं गृहस्थस्य वर्णी तु द्विगुणं चरेत्त्रिगुणं तु वनस्थस्य यतीनां तु चतुर्गुणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्त्रीशूद्राणां यथा शोचं सर्वेषां च मनः शुचिः कृत्वा द्वादशगण्डूषं मलसूत्रे तु षड्भवेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रवेशयेत्करं सव्यं जले चामणि बन्धनम् तत आदायहस्तेन प्राङ्मुखः सलिलं पिबेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: समन्त्रकमशब्दं च हृदयस्थे जले पुनः अङ्गुष्ठानाभिकाभ्यं च द्वादशाङ्गानि संस्पृशेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मध्ये मध्ये जलं स्पृश्य तत्तदेवं सु चिन्तयेत्परिमृश्य द्विरास्यं तु सकृदोष्ठौ परिस्पृशेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वेदत्रयं समुच्चार्यमाषमात्रजलं पिबेत्त्वं न्यूनमधिकं पीतं सुरेति कवयो विदुः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: व्याहृतीभिश्चतुर्वारं त्रिः पिबेत्प्रणवेन वा सावित्र्या व पिबेदम्बू त्रिः पिबेद्वाप्यामन्त्रकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: गोकर्णवत्करं कृत्वा गृह्णीयाद्देवतीर्थतः पिबे च ब्रह्मतीर्थे न दिवा वीक्ष्य जलं पिबेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पिबेद्विप्रो जले ह्यस्थे कर्मस्थे बाहुजः पुनः वैश्याशूद्रास्तथा नार्य आस्यस्थे च पुनाति च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पवित्रं धारयन्विप्रः शुद्धाचमनमाचरेत् वैधेकर्मणि मत्याज्यं पवित्रं त्वन्यथात्मजेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्रह्मगन्धिं कर्मकाले भुक्तिकाले च वर्तुलम् चतुभिर्दर्भपिञ्जूलैर्ब्राह्मणस्य पवित्रकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एकैकं न्यूनमुद्दिष्टं वर्णे वर्णे यथा क्रमम् दन्तशुद्धिं ततः कुर्याद्दन्तकाष्ठैः शुभैः समैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: क्षीरवृक्षोद्भवैः कुर्याद्यद्वा कण्टकवृक्षकैः काघासैः क्रमुकैः काशैः खर्गुरश्च निषिद्धजैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न कुर्द्दन्तसि शुद्ध्यं च कृत्वा सद्यो त्यजो भवेत्प्रादक्षिण्या क्रमेणैव मन्दयन्त्रेन कारयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रतीपद्भूतषष्ठीषु नवभ्यामथपर्वसु श्राद्धाहे दन्तशुद्धिश्चेद्दहत्यासप्तमकुलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सप्तम्यामसितार्केषु श्रवणे जन्मभेदथा न कुर्याद्दन्तशुध्यं तौ गण्डूषान्द्दादशाचरेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऐन्द्रे सम्पदमाप्नोति ऐशान्यां सर्वसिद्धयः इतरत्र महान्दोषः पुत्रस्त्रीपशुनाशनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एवं दन्तानूशुची कृत्वा पुनराचम्य बुद्धिमान् संकल्प्य विधिपूर्वं तु ततः स्नातुमुपक्रमेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
